text.en:
No. S 31

CORRIGENDUM

CONSTITUTION OF UNIVERSITI BRUNEI DARUSSALAM (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1991 In the English version of the Constitution of Universiti Brunei Darussalam (Amendment) Order, 1991 published in the Government Gazette Part II No. 17 on 30th. September, 1991 at page 395 in the marginal note, the words and figure "Amendment of section 4" should read "Amendment of section 15".
